statements.proposition: The change to getTransformValues keeps the library's existing public API backward compatible.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: getTransformValues keeps its signature and is not exported from the package entry (src/index.ts exports components and shared only, not utils). Internally its return for 'none' changed from [] to identity and for matrix3d from 16 values to identity, but its only caller getScaleMultipliers only acts when length is 6 and dividing by identity 1 is a no-op, so getScaleMultipliers results are the same in those cases. Not exercised with a before/after run.
